note: Conditional analytic extension beyond the sampled exponents. For s>0 assume the stated operator has a strictly positive continuous eigenfunction h, eigenvalue λ. At n steps, freeze each terminal h at the image of zero. Unimodular cylinder diameters are ≤1/(n+1), so the normalized sums converge uniformly to h. Each summand decreases weakly. The suffix BA supplies slope in [1,2] and normalized mass h(1)/λ² at zero. Therefore h(x)−h(y) ≥ (h(1)/λ²)·2s·(y−x)/3^(2s+1) for x<y. Two-step positive comparison gives strict decrease of λ with s whenever both positive eigenfunctions exist. At s=0 the frozen sums are constant. Full argument in the script docstring. Exact rational checks cover 2,047 prefixes; truncating the suffix loses its slope bound. The proof assumes positive eigenfunction existence and does not certify the decimal eigenvalues or subleading spectrum. No producer implementation used.
